subscriptions_korea_purchase_disclosure.description: Inline legal disclosure on Korea subscription pricing, even while store prices are unavailable. Preserve all three Markdown links and their opaque IDs korea_cancellation, korea_refund_policy, korea_terms_of_use; translators may reorder the linked phrases.
